summary: Phase 4 retest of the 3 reported fixes + full regression. Backend: full suite 181/181 PASSED (pytest -n2), including the two previously failing TestSplitAndDebts::test_debts_scenario (alice +50 / bob -50, settlements [{bob->alice,50}]) and ::test_debts_missing_rate. Empty-members debts path now returns home_currency (members.py:370). Frontend: (a) clipboard blocked (navigator.clipboard.writeText rejecting NotAllowedError + execCommand throwing) -> 'Copy blocked — long-press the link to copy manually' toast, NO CRA runtime-error overlay, dialog stays usable; (b) after owner removed the viewer via API, /version + /presence polling stopped — only 3 residual requests in the first ~10s and 0 requests in the 10-20s window (previously an endless 404 stream); (c) regressions green: external mutation (SYNCED_STOP added by another session) appeared without reload within the 5s poll, presence pod showed the other user ~5s after their heartbeat, ExpenseModal split checkboxes toggle and show '€30.00 per person', expense persisted and Spend total updated to €90.00.

minor.issue: Expenses with an empty split_between (ExpenseModal allows unchecking every member) are silently skipped, so the cost shows in 'Spend total' (e.g. €90) but contributes nothing to balances/settlements. Consider defaulting split to the payer or validating non-empty split.
invite_url is returned relative ('/invite/<token>') because FRONTEND_URL is not set in backend/.env — the copied link is not shareable outside the app. Carried over from iteration 9.
Body validation still runs before role check (viewer gets 422 instead of 403); dead `existing` query in create_invite; re-visited accepted invite returns 404 instead of 410; no PATCH /api/trips/{id}.

ui_bugs.issue: After the user is removed from a trip, polling correctly stops but the page keeps rendering the stale trip content and the VIEWER role badge — no 'you no longer have access' state until a reload. Low priority UX gap.

action_items: No blocking action items — all three reported fixes are verified working and the whole backend suite is green.
Optional: set FRONTEND_URL so invite_url is absolute; decide behaviour for expenses with empty split_between; render an access-revoked state on the trip page once polling stops.
critical_code_review_comments: members.py:423-431 — greedy algorithm now operates on dict copies; balances_list is returned untouched. Correct.

useTripSync.js — the very first tick() runs before `timer` is assigned, so a 404 on the first call cannot clear the (not-yet-created) interval; the next tick clears it. Costs at most one extra request (observed 2-3 residual requests). Acceptable, but a `stopped` ref would be cleaner and also guard the visibilitychange re-tick.

useTripPresence.js — same pattern; heartbeat and list intervals are cleared independently on 401/403/404. The `currentEditing` effect still posts presence with a bare .catch(() => {}) and is not gated by the stop flag (one-off request, harmless).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (clipboard fallback, polling stop, sync, presence, expense split)

seed_data_creation: Two throwaway trips seeded via /app/test_reports/seed_ui_iter10.py (owners i10owner_d6edc2@twt.app, i10owner_4bcf2e@twt.app) — both DELETEd at the end of the run. Dev users remain in the users collection.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — POST /api/auth/dev-login {email,name}; POST /api/auth/dev-login-as {email,trip_id,role} (ENV=dev). Cookie twt_session or Bearer session_token.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 181 backend tests pass (pytest /app/backend/tests/ -q). Trip page testids: members-open-btn, rates-open-btn, trip-role-badge, presence-pod, add-expense-btn (in ExpensesSection), add-stop-btn. MembersDialog uses invite-send-btn (not invite-submit-btn) and invite-copy-btn. IMPORTANT for ExpenseModal: split_between is pre-checked for ALL accepted members by default — clicking the split-option labels UNCHECKS them; use locator('[data-testid^="split-option-"] input[type=checkbox]').check(). To block the clipboard use page.add_init_script overriding navigator.clipboard.writeText + document.execCommand. To simulate a second session use fetch(..., {credentials:'omit', headers:{Authorization:'Bearer <session_token>'}}).
rca_of_the_issue: Previous defects confirmed fixed: (1) balances aliasing — settlement loop now runs on dict copies, so balances survive serialization; (2) copyLink wrapped in try/catch with textarea+execCommand fallback and an error toast, so a rejected writeText no longer escapes as an unhandled rejection into the CRA overlay; (3) both hooks inspect e.response.status and clearInterval on 401/403/404, stopping the 404 flood after membership removal (measured: 0 polling requests 10s after removal).
